investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 172.16.1.0/24 (172.16.1.1 through 172.16.1.255); Domain: pcapworkshop.net; Domain Controller IP address: 172.16.1.16; Domain Controller host name: PCAPWORKSHOP-DC; LAN segment gateway: 172.16.1.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 172.16.1.255.
